messages:
sarah: Quick heads-up — we're running a dry-run for an incoming penetration test next Tue. Need an ops handshake, KMS access plan, and evidence packaging checklist. Who can own ephemeral creds + presigned bucket?

mike: I can own ephemeral creds + presigned S3. For KMS we must NOT export keys. We'll use a kms-proxy endpoint that performs Decrypt/Wrap only. Suggest two roles: pen_test_assessor (scoped read-only to logs + s3:GetObject) and pen_test_ops (timebound escalation).

nina: I'll take audit log snapshot. Prefer JSONL export with SIEM correlation IDs. Which time range do you want captured? Also need confirmation that CloudTrail trail is isolated to pt-logs-bucket.

raj: Recommend exporting 48h prior to the window and 7d after for context. For RBAC, here's a minimal IAM policy template to create a time-limited role (please validate):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-key-1"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:RequestTag/pt-session":"true"}}}
  ]
}
```

ashley: For remediation tracking, let's use the triage board (JIRA) and tag issues with label `pt-critical` / `pt-info`. Each ticket should include repro steps, affected service, and evidence link. We'll enforce a weekly triage cadence during the remediations sprint.

sarah: Important constraint — assessors must NOT be able to read KMS plaintext. The kms-proxy must perform unwrap/wrap operations and log requests. Use a RequestTag `pt-session=true` so policy conditions can be enforced.

mike: Plan for creds: create a temp role with AssumeRole TTL matching the test window and pre-generate creds for the dry-run. Evidence upload flow (example):
```bash
curl -F file=@evidence.zip https://presigned-upload.redwood.internal/upload
# or
aws s3 cp evidence.zip s3://redwood-pt-evidence/assessor-uploads/evidence.zip --expires-in 259200
```

pt-bot: Reminder: presigned object URLs should use TTL <= 72h for dry-run. Example presign command: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/assessor-uploads/evidence.zip --expires-in 259200` :warning:

nina: Also we need a dedicated CloudTrail trail for the engagement (pt-trail) pointed to pt-logs-bucket, retention 90d. Capture VPC Flow Logs + ALB access logs for the test window. I'll provision an export job and post the manifest prior to the window.

raj: Proposed retest slots: Tue 09:00-11:00 PST and Thu 14:00-16:00 PST. Ops on-call: @mike, @nina. We'll run an `evidence-check` smoke script after uploads to validate checksums and metadata.

ashley: Adding the playbook checklist link here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/XYZ123 (private). Checklist highlights: 1) IAM role created & scoped, 2) KMS proxy healthy, 3) evidence bucket + presigned link ready, 4) CloudTrail export completed, 5) triage board template ready.

sarah: Thanks — I'll assemble the short playbook and assign owners by EOD. Please ping in this thread when your piece is complete (role, proxy healthcheck, farmed presign). If anyone hits RBAC edge-cases (cross-account access, Condition tag mismatch), call it out now so we can pre-adjust before assessor onboarding. :+1:
